title: Staging Connector Agent generic deny-by-default Docker subtree packaging

phases.objective: Reject all unmanifested Connector content generically at the Docker context boundary, avoiding per-directory exceptions while preserving exact-Git staging provenance and fail-closed image verification.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Exact-Git-archive Docker build and Connector Agent image asset verifier
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Only the manifest-declared Connector files are packaged, nested workflow sources stay excluded, and missing/extra image entries continue to fail closed.
steps: Validate the generic local-connector/** deny rule occurs after the directory traversal exception and before all release-file exceptions.
Execute the source-time Connector asset verifier and Local Manager release-owner regression tests.
Build the exact Staging image with BuildKit and reject missing or extra Connector release assets.
Execute a real Docker BuildKit COPY on the checked-out candidate and require exact release-file set parity.
assertions: All nested Connector directories, present and future, are denied by a generic subtree rule without hardcoded names.
Only manifest-listed top-level Connector release files override the generic deny rule.
Image-stage checks still enforce the exact file set and reject unexpected files or directories.
Exact Git archive provenance stays intact.
No changes to Production, database state, live Staging, or credentials.
Real Docker BuildKit context smoke test must package exactly the API manifest's Connector release files, with no unknown nested directories or additional files.
